tools.name: get_my_membership
tools.title: Get my membership record
tools.description: Read the signed-in member's own Region 17 record: member number, credential ID, handle, standing dates and status. Returns nothing for a signed-in user who has not yet registered.

tools.name: list_my_consents
tools.title: List my consents and affirmations
tools.description: Read the signed-in member's own consent history (one row per consent, with grant and revocation times and policy version) and their Compact affirmation records. Read only: consent records are append-only and can only be changed in the app.

tools.name: list_ghana_regions
tools.title: List Ghana's regions
tools.description: Reference list of Ghana's sixteen regions with slug, name and capital. The seventeenth region is the diaspora itself and is not a row here.

slug.description: Return one region by slug instead of all sixteen.
